import numpy as np, pandas as pd, re, requests, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})
three2one=dict(ALA="A",ARG="R",ASN="N",ASP="D",CYS="C",GLN="Q",GLU="E",GLY="G",HIS="H",ILE="I",
 LEU="L",LYS="K",MET="M",PHE="F",PRO="P",SER="S",THR="T",TRP="W",TYR="Y",VAL="V")

def read_pdb_model1(path):
    rows=[]; started=False; done=False
    for ln in open(path):
        if ln.startswith("MODEL"):
            if started: done=True
            started=True
        if done: break
        if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
            rn=ln[17:20].strip()
            if rn in three2one:
                rows.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(),res=rn,resi=int(ln[22:26]),
                                 x=float(ln[30:38]),y=float(ln[38:46]),z=float(ln[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

base="/agent/jobs/2ad3ca98-7375-4057-801b-fd07bae4ffff/provenance/"
P_cmc4=read_pdb_model1(base+"AF_Sp_cmc4_G2TRJ8.pdb")
P_hs  =read_pdb_model1(base+"1HP8.pdb")
P_cox =read_pdb_model1(base+"1U97.pdb")
for nm,d in [("AF cmc4",P_cmc4),("1HP8 p8MTCP1",P_hs),("1U97 apo Cox17",P_cox)]:
    ca=d[d.name=="CA"]
    print(nm,"n_res",len(ca),"range",ca.resi.min(),"-",ca.resi.max(),
          "seq:", "".join(three2one[r] for r in ca.res))

def kabsch(A,B):
    """superpose B onto A; returns rmsd, rotated B"""
    ca_=A.mean(0); cb=B.mean(0)
    H=(B-cb).T@(A-ca_)
    U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
    Bf=(B-cb)@R.T+ca_
    return float(np.sqrt(((Bf-A)**2).sum(1).mean())), Bf, R, ca_, cb

def ca_dict(d):
    c=d[d.name=="CA"]
    return {int(r.resi):np.array([r.x,r.y,r.z]) for r in c.itertuples()}

C1=ca_dict(P_cmc4); C2=ca_dict(P_hs); C3=ca_dict(P_cox)

# --- (A) cmc4 vs human CMC4/p8MTCP1 (1HP8), correspondence from BLOSUM62 alignment ---
# alignment computed earlier: Sp 4,9,14,25,35,36 <-> Hs 7,12,17,28,38,39 ; offset +3 for 1..~45
corr=[(i, i+3) for i in range(3,47) if i in C1 and i+3 in C2]          # N-terminal CHCH block, offset +3
corr+= [(i, i-4) for i in range(50,70) if i in C1 and i-4 in C2]        # C-terminal helix 3, offset -4
corr=[(a,b) for a,b in corr if a in C1 and b in C2]
A=np.array([C2[b] for a,b in corr]); B=np.array([C1[a] for a,b in corr])
rmsd,Bf,R,t1,t2=kabsch(A,B)
print(f"\n[A] cmc4(AF) -> human CMC4 p8MTCP1 (1HP8 NMR): {len(corr)} CA pairs, RMSD = {rmsd:.2f} A")
dev=np.sqrt(((Bf-A)**2).sum(1))
keep=dev<3.0
while True:
    A2=A[keep]; B2=B[keep]
    r2,Bf2,_,_,_=kabsch(A2,B2)
    full=(B-B[keep].mean(0))  # recompute on full using core transform
    break
print(f"    core subset ({keep.sum()} pairs within 3 A): RMSD = {r2:.2f} A")
print(f"    fraction of aligned CA within 3 A: {keep.mean():.2f}; within 4 A: {(dev<4).mean():.2f}")
# disulfide-anchor RMSD
anch=[(4,7),(14,17),(25,28),(35,38),(36,39)]
Aa=np.array([C2[b] for a,b in anch]); Ba=np.array([C1[a] for a,b in anch])
ra,_,_,_,_=kabsch(Aa,Ba)
print(f"    CHCH cysteine CA anchors only (5 pairs): RMSD = {ra:.2f} A")

# --- (B) cmc4 vs apo yeast Cox17 (1U97), anchored on the four CHCH cysteines ---
# Sc Cox17 CHCH Cys: 26,36,47,57  <-> cmc4 4,14,25,35
anch2=[(4,26),(14,36),(25,47),(35,57)]
print("\n1U97 residues present:", sorted(C3.keys())[:5],"...",sorted(C3.keys())[-5:])
anch2=[(a,b) for a,b in anch2 if a in C1 and b in C3]
Ab=np.array([C3[b] for a,b in anch2]); Bb_=np.array([C1[a] for a,b in anch2])
rb,Bbf,Rb,tb1,tb2=kabsch(Ab,Bb_)
print(f"[B] cmc4(AF) -> apo yeast Cox17 (1U97 NMR), 4 CHCH-Cys CA anchors: RMSD = {rb:.2f} A")
# after anchoring, how many cmc4 CA land near any Cox17 CA?
allB=np.array([C1[k] for k in sorted(C1)]); allBf=(allB-Bb_.mean(0))@Rb.T+Ab.mean(0)
allA=np.array([C3[k] for k in sorted(C3)])
dmin=np.array([np.min(np.linalg.norm(allA-p,axis=1)) for p in allBf])
print(f"    cmc4 residues with a Cox17 CA within 4 A after CHCH anchoring: {(dmin<4).sum()}/{len(dmin)}")

# same metric for the human comparison
allBf2=(allB-B.mean(0))@R.T+A.mean(0)
allA2=np.array([C2[k] for k in sorted(C2)])
dmin2=np.array([np.min(np.linalg.norm(allA2-p,axis=1)) for p in allBf2])
print(f"    cmc4 residues with a p8MTCP1 CA within 4 A after full superposition: {(dmin2<4).sum()}/{len(dmin2)}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4))
ks=sorted(C1)
ax.plot(ks,dmin2,"o-",ms=3,lw=1.4,color="#2b6cb0",label="vs human CMC4/p8MTCP1 (1HP8, NMR)")
ax.plot(ks,dmin,"s-",ms=3,lw=1.4,color="#c05621",label="vs apo yeast Cox17 (1U97, NMR)")
ax.axhline(4,ls="--",color="grey",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("S. pombe cmc4 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("distance to nearest CA in target (A)")
ax.set_title("cmc4 AlphaFold model matches human CMC4, not Cox17",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_ylim(0,None)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
